name: radarvitals-audit
description: On the public clinical radar dataset of Schellenberger et al. (24 GHz radar, 30 adults, ECG and continuous finger pressure), the within-subject evaluation protocols used by learned heart-rate and blood-pressure estimators are matched by a lookup of each subject's resting value, and a generic network that reaches the same errors identifies the subject from a radar window with 99% accuracy. On held-out subjects the network falls to the population median at rest, while the dataset authors' own classical pipeline scores 0.6 beats per minute. Pooling the five recording scenarios makes subject-disjoint heart rate learnable. radarvitals-audit holds the window and label derivation, every estimator and protocol, the released split files, and tests that pin every number the paper reports.
